name: JellyWatchParty
description: Watch movies together in sync with friends on Jellyfin
overview: Synchronized watch parties for Jellyfin. Create or join rooms to watch content together with friends, perfectly in sync.

## What's Changed
* fix: v12 floating button overlaps other plugins; replace SyncPlay when configured by @TIGamingTV in https://github.com/TIGamingTV/JellyWatchParty/pull/63


**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/TIGamingTV/JellyWatchParty/compare/v2.0.1.0...v2.0.2.0

## What's Changed
* Drop Jellyfin 10.11.x support, target Jellyfin 12.x only by @TIGamingTV in https://github.com/TIGamingTV/JellyWatchParty/pull/61
* fix: Jellyfin 12's default layout hides the header button by @TIGamingTV in https://github.com/TIGamingTV/JellyWatchParty/pull/62


**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/TIGamingTV/JellyWatchParty/compare/v2.0.0.0...v2.0.1.0

**This release brings JWP to jellyfin-rc7**

## What's Changed
* docs: fix broken tables and dead internal links by @TIGamingTV in https://github.com/TIGamingTV/JellyWatchParty/pull/56
* Implement dual-target build for Jellyfin 10.11 + 12.x support by @TIGamingTV in https://github.com/TIGamingTV/JellyWatchParty/pull/57
* Claude/jellyfin v12 rc3 testing sakmhg by @TIGamingTV in https://github.com/TIGamingTV/JellyWatchParty/pull/59
* Restore the dual-target Jellyfin 10.11 + 12.x build clobbered by the #59 merge by @TIGamingTV in https://github.com/TIGamingTV/JellyWatchParty/pull/60


**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/TIGamingTV/JellyWatchParty/compare/v1.8.0.0...v2.0.0.0
